name: Serug
title: Ancestor in the lineage from Shem to Abraham
summary: Serug was the son of Reu and the father of Nahor in the patriarchal lineage from Shem to Abraham. According to the Bible, he lived for 230 years and is a vital link in the genealogy connecting Noah's son Shem with Abraham, the father of faith. He is mentioned in the genealogies in Genesis and in the Gospel of Luke.

keyEvents.title: The birth of Serug
keyEvents.description: Serug was born when his father Reu was 32 years old, as part of the patriarchal lineage after the flood.

keyEvents.title: Serug becomes the father of Nahor
keyEvents.description: When Serug was 30 years old, he became the father of Nahor, who continued the lineage toward Abraham.

keyEvents.title: Serug's Later Life and Descendants
keyEvents.description: After Nahor was born, Serug lived for another 200 years and had more sons and daughters. His total lifespan was 230 years.

keyEvents.title: Serug in 1 Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Serug is mentioned in the genealogy of 1 Chronicles as part of the line from Shem to Abraham.

keyEvents.title: Serug in Jesus' Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Serug is included in Jesus' genealogy in the Gospel of Luke, showing Jesus' ancestry tracing back through all human history to Adam.
